_note: Path prefixes containing '*' use glob-aware matching (fnmatch-style): '*/docs/dev/overnight/' matches that directory under any worktree. A prefix starting with '/' is anchored at the project root. The shared protected list is the SOLE catch-all for /.claude/ — DO NOT add broad '/.claude/' to denied prefixes; use only the explicit subdirs above so legitimate worktree paths remain writable. Allow prefixes name directories (ending in '/') or wildcards (ending in '*'), and the /dev/null, /dev/stderr and /dev/stdout devices, never the file of an artifact: hooks/pretool-tool-policy.py derives an artifact's write permission from the session's dispatch records (P1b E3). A path a dispatch's obligation declares (with the producer question it names and what the template it was dispatched from declares in the current command files) is written by that dispatch only, whatever these rows allow, and the role's deny prefixes still apply to it; an undeclared path keeps these rows. Deny prefixes grant nothing and all stay. cp-state files have one writer, scripts/spec-check.py (pretool-cp-state-write-guard.py). The managed scratch namespace '*/.claude/scratch/' is granted to every role; raw /tmp and /var/tmp are denied for every role, including one holding '*', except that role's own exact temp entries ('*/tmp/claude-scratch/<role>/', '*/var/tmp/codex-outputs/', '<state dir>/agentic-commit/<role>/'). A JSON prefix cannot express actor identity, so raw-temp denial and owner-vs-sibling scratch exactness are enforced behaviorally by hooks/pretool-tool-policy.py; these rows are the declaration, not the sole enforcement. policy_version 8 (P1b): every allow prefix that named an artifact's file went, with user.allowed_path_prefixes, which nothing read.

user.rationale: User simulation: Playwright/read for user-flow testing; writes what its dispatch's obligation declares (pretool-tool-policy.py derives that permission from the dispatch record), plus its overnight, codex and scratch directories; no source/protected/test edits

ui-specialist.rationale: UI specialist DESIGN_MODE: read + screenshot; writes what its dispatch's obligation declares (pretool-tool-policy.py derives that permission from the dispatch record), plus its overnight, codex and scratch directories; forbid app-source writes and protected infrastructure

ba.rationale: BA: analysis; writes what its dispatch's obligation declares and the producer question that obligation names (pretool-tool-policy.py derives that permission from the dispatch record), plus its research, codex, overnight and scratch directories; no code/agent/hook writes

dev.rationale: Dev: write per files_to_modify/files_to_create from BA context; orchestrator-level enforcement of scope. A path another dispatch's obligation declares is that dispatch's alone, whatever '*' allows (pretool-tool-policy.py)

qa.rationale: QA: read + verify; writes what its dispatch's obligation declares (pretool-tool-policy.py derives that permission from the dispatch record), plus its codex, overnight and scratch directories; no app/source/test edits

pm.rationale: PM: read + plan/triage/retro; writes what its dispatch's obligation declares under the overnight directory (pretool-tool-policy.py derives that permission from the dispatch record), plus its codex and scratch directories; no implementation

test-writer.rationale: test-writer (spec-20260518-225715 §5.2): generates pytest skeleton tests from BA-produced acceptance-criteria JSON under tests/generated/ and writes what its dispatch's obligation declares (pretool-tool-policy.py derives that permission from the dispatch record); explicitly forbidden from src/app/lib and all protected /.claude/ subdirs. Read access is broad (analyses AC JSON, spec files, existing tests for archive/idempotency keying).

spec.rationale: spec: may write the spec folders and scratch only; the views directory its dispatch's obligation declares is its alone (pretool-tool-policy.py); no source/protected/test edits.

changelog-analyst.rationale: changelog-analyst: git commit operations; reads dev-artifacts, stages and commits source changes via Bash (git add/commit). Its Write tool writes only the message file of its own `git commit -F`, a scratch input, under its scratch directory; the push-gate token is written by scripts/write-push-gate-token.py, never by Write; no write access to protected infra

push-analyst.rationale: push-analyst: pre-push git read-only analysis; reads commits-to-push range, sensitive file patterns, and divergence; writes nonce-keyed grant to <state dir>/agentic-commit/push-analyst/ (role-specific directory only, no broad /tmp/*; the /tmp entry is the default state dir's exception to the raw-temp denial, the */ entry a CLAUDE_STATE_DIR outside the temp roots); no write access to protected infra

merge-analyst.rationale: merge-analyst: pre-merge git read-only analysis; reads branch divergence, diff stat, conflict markers, and overnight-state for consistency validation; writes one nonce-keyed grant (60s expiry) with the Write tool to <state dir>/agentic-commit/merge-analyst/, checked on that Write by posttool-allowlist-consume.py (lib/merge_grant.py) and read by /merge (role-specific directory only, no broad /tmp/*; the /tmp entry is the default state dir's exception to the raw-temp denial, the */ entry a CLAUDE_STATE_DIR outside the temp roots); no write access to protected infra

pull-analyst.rationale: pull-analyst: post-pull advisory analysis only; reads new-commits range and semantic risk indicators (dependency manifests, schema files, API surface, CI/CD); Write tool excluded to enforce advisory-only contract — pull-analyst writes no grant and blocks nothing; no write access to protected infra

graphify.rationale: graphify: /dev Step 9 enrichment subagent; runs graphify-enrich.py via Bash, which writes the task's run record and focused subgraph under .claude/dev-registry/<task_id>/graphify/ and never the context (the graph cache is graphify-maintain.py's). Its Write grant is scoped to that graphify sub-directory, not the whole dev-registry, so it cannot author peer artifacts. No Skill/Edit (graphify.md uses neither). No write access to protected infra.
